## Who to ask what

| Your question is about… | Ask |
|---|---|
| A lab exercise that won't pass, environment issues | The lab session itself (fastest), then the TA |
| Homework clarification | The Moodle forum thread for that HW — answers there reach everyone |
| A grade ([regrade policy](policies.qmd#grading)) | Written regrade request within 7 days |
| Project scope, topic, or a stuck experiment | Project office hours (bring the measured table you have, however small) |
| Exam logistics, accommodations, life events | The instructor, as early as possible — [late policy](policies.qmd#late-policy) |
| A broken link or typo on this site | The "Report an issue" link on any page — fixes land quickly |

One norm worth stating: questions asked in the open (forum, lab room)
outrank private messages for anything that isn't personal — every answer
in the open saves thirty people the same email, and the course treats
asking visible questions as a contribution, not an imposition.
